answer_2.quote: We measure accuracy to evaluate both OIE slot linking to KGs ( §5.1), and Out-of-KG detection of OIE slots ( §5.2). To measure OIE fact linking, we score a hit if all OIE slots are linked correctly.

answer_4.quote: To verify that this strategy indeed has high precision, we randomly sample 100 test instances, and conduct a human-study with two expert annotators. The annotators found 97% correct pairings (inter-annotator agreement of 99%; Kohen's kappa of 0.80); see Appendix F for details.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators evaluated the correctness of the OIE-KG fact alignments.
